## Highlights
- **🕒 Time in the Updated column.** On a class page's **Past Assignments** table, the **Updated** column now shows the time a grade was entered or changed under the date, like "11/23/26" and "3:00 PM". Alma already knew the exact time but only showed the date.

## Changes
- The time appears in a small gray line under Alma's date, and stays put when you sort the table.
- Removed the **Updated** row from the Gradebook tab that was added in 2.15.2. The time belongs in Alma's own Updated column instead.
- Also new today: **New grade alerts** (2.15) and updated time plus grade in the Overview page's **New & Updated Assignments** (2.15.1).

## How to update
1. Download the zip below and unzip it.
2. Copy its files over your old Alma+ folder (same place, same folder name).
3. Go to `chrome://extensions` and click reload ↻ on Alma+, then refresh Alma.
4. Open any class and look at the **Updated** column in Past Assignments.

> ⚠️ Don't remove the extension to update — removing it deletes your saved tasks. Back up your tasks first with **Back up tasks** on the To Do page if you're unsure.
